metadata.title: Saves & Miis — Nebula
metadata.description: Back up your progress, continue from Dolphin and choose a Mii for your file.

page.paragraph_2: Back up your progress, continue from Dolphin and choose a Mii for your file.
page.paragraph_3: These instructions cover the upcoming update. The current public download is v1.0.2.

backup.heading_1: Keep a copy of your progress.
backup.paragraph_1: Close the game. In the launcher, open Advanced → Export saves. Nebula creates a dated ZIP file containing your save data. Keep it somewhere outside the installation folder.

dolphin.paragraph_1: In Dolphin, right-click Super Mario Galaxy and choose Open Wii Save Folder. Use a save for the supported North American version.
dolphin.paragraph_2: Do not import or export while the game is running.
dolphin.paragraph_3: Open the launcher → Advanced → Import saves → From a folder, then choose the Dolphin save folder.
dolphin.paragraph_4: Start the game and check the imported save. Nebula backs up your existing saves before importing.

location.paragraph_1: On Windows, saves are stored in
location.paragraph_2: . Before importing, Nebula moves existing saves to a dated
location.paragraph_3: folder. You can also import a previously exported Nebula save ZIP through the launcher.
location.paragraph_4: Setup’s Uninstall mode keeps saves and settings. Export a backup before a major update or moving to another computer.

miis.paragraph_1: In v2, open Settings → General → Import Miis. Imported Miis appear in the save-file icon picker. Wii, DS, 3DS, Wii U, Switch, Mii Studio and Mii Creator sources are supported; exact file-format guidance will accompany the release.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
